description:
TRB Technologies (TRBT) goal is the creation of a self-contained biosphere for lunar or Martian colonies. To do this, we have designed a series of grow modules to provide a healthy, varied diet within a community context. these modules form what we call our TRB AgriFood EcoSystem, a modular and flexible bicircular and sustainable approach to food growth and production. 
To fund our goal, we intend to revolutionise terrestrial supply chains through selling our innovative technologies, capable of growing localised high-yielding varied diets, including protein supporting food security and sustainable urban agriculture. Our vision for space colonisation thinking was efficiency of the whole food system, from: technologies to grow production and processing and waste minimisation and reuse. 
TRBT’s system includes converting the ‘food waste’ in to additional products and /or uses. TRBT aligns with UN SDGs and Net Zero policies to drive social, economic, and environmental impact, ensuring equitable food access while reducing food miles, fossil fuel use, and promoting local, climate-resilient food.

entityDescription:
Space Industry Development Agency ZRT. (SIDA) is an independent Hungarian organization committed to advancing the sustainable commercial utilization of outer space. Established to act as a strategic platform for the national and international space sector, SIDA facilitates cross-sectoral collaboration and innovation by connecting current and potential stakeholders involved in space-related activities.Our core mission is to serve as a catalyst for integrating space technologies and services into broader economic ecosystems, thereby enabling companies—particularly those with established success in other industries—to access and contribute to the rapidly evolving space market.
Key strategic functions include:
- Stakeholder Integration:Acting as a connector between commercial, academic, and governmental actors to create synergies and drive space industry growth.
- Space Sector Enablement:Supporting enterprises in translating their existing capabilities into space-compatible solutions, including downstream and upstream opportunities.
- Commercialization Support:Promoting and facilitating sustainable business models related to space-based applications and services.
- Innovation Platform:Providing access to technical, regulatory, and market intelligence to support innovation across satellite systems, communications, Earth observation, and emerging space markets.
SIDA’s operations are aligned with both national policy goals and international standards, including ESA frameworks, and the agency is registered in ESA STAR to participate in European Space Agency tenders and collaborations.

Agricolus Agritech Spain is a product company that operates in the field of precision agriculture with the mission of revolutionizing the agriculture industry by specializing in smart and precision farming techniques. We are dedicated to enhancing productivity and sustainability in orchards, protected horticulture, and dryland farming. This can be done leveraging a variety of innovative technologies, including computer vision, super-resolution imagery and more. Our primary focus is to empower farmers with cutting-edge technology to optimize crop yield, conserve resources and improve profitability, providing them with increased yields, reduced resource usage and enhanced financial returns.
The company was born from the awareness of the sole shareholder Agricolus that in the precision agriculture sector in Spain a functional and adequate response to management in arid areas is required, hence the decision to create a company in Spain that would focus on the supply of these services and the potential of the sector specifically.
The activities of Agricolus Agritech Spain aim to practically contribute to the transition of the agricultural sector towards a more sustainable and resilient future, and for this reason the company will invest in numerous industrial research projects both at a national and international level, also with a view to increasing its skills.

Kelluu´s mission is to revolutionize aerial intelligence by persistently capturing and digitizing the physical world below the clouds by building the world’s most accurate and persistent aerial monitoring system — a new layer of reality that supports smarter, safer and more sustainable decisions. 

At the heart of Kelluu’s technology are autonomous, long-endurance airships that fly quietly over cities, infrastructure and landscapes, even under harsh environmental conditions, from extreme Arctic cold to other challenging weather scenarios. They gather ultra-high-resolution, georeferenced data that’s used to create live digital twins, 3D models that reflect the real world in stunning detail, down to better than 2 cm accuracy.
By providing a continuously updated, precise, and comprehensive digital representation of the world, Kelluu empowers informed decision-making, enhances security capabilities, and supports global sustainable development

PlusZero Ltd is a Scottish based group of companies focussing on the production and distribution of green hydrogen. PlusZero Ltd as parent company drives brand development and leads on the core innovation aspects of the business. 

Companies under PlusZero Ltd include; PlusZero Energy, PlusZero Power and PlusZero Engine Systems. 

PlusZero Energy is PlusZero's hydrogen production company with plants in development in the Scottish Western Isles. 

PlusZero Power focusses on the application of various hydrogen technologies supporting the development of the Hydrogen economy. The primary focus is on Hydrogen Internal Combustion Engine (HICE) based generator deployment and other HICE based off road machinery and associated hydrogen supply into sectors including: Construction, Ports/ Marine, Forestry, Agriculture, Events and Film & TV.

mhackeroni is Italy’s foremost ethical hacking team and a non-profit association. Its members come from both the academic and professional worlds, including researchers at top international institutions and cybersecurity experts from prominent companies.

entityDescription:
Institute profile
Institut für Mikroelektronik Stuttgart carries out industrial-oriented microelectronic research in silicon technology, customized circuits (ASIC), nano structuring and image sensor technology as well as being involved in professional development. It is a foundation recognized as a non-profit organization under civil law with its headquarters on the Stuttgart-Vaihingen research campus. The research facility is a member of the Innovationsallianz Baden-Württemberg (innBW), a cooperation among twelve contract research organizations in Baden-Württemberg.
The foundation
The research facility was founded on July 18th, 1983, by the state of Baden-Württemberg.
Its legal form is a foundation under civil law. The foundation’s mission is to conduct research and development in the field of microelectronic circuits and systems and to ensure that the results of its work are implemented in industrial practice. This task particularly includes
- the construction and operation of research and development facilities for the design of microelectronic circuits and systems
- the construction and operation of process lines for the production of microelectronic experimental, sample and prototype circuits
- the execution of research and development projects on behalf of the federal government, the states and research institutions
- the promotion of practical training of scientific and technical personnel in the field of microelectronics.

Quality certificates and environmental protection declaration
As a research facility with our own pilot and small series production, we have current certification according to ISO9001:2015. In 1993, we were the first German research institution ever to receive ISO9001 certification, thus setting new standards. We also regard environmental protection as an important part of the research facility’s policy. It is our duty to reduce adverse effects on the environment to a minimum. We ensure that our environmental policy is upheld on all levels of the institute and updated, if necessary. Raydiant RF GmbH is a Berlin-based high-tech startup specializing in the development of advanced, application-specific directional antenna systems. Founded in August 2024, the company brings together decades of industrial experience and academic expertise. The founders served as antenna system architects in the Future Combat Air System (FCAS) program, one of Europe’s most advanced defense initiatives, and are recognized experts in high-frequency and beamforming technologies.
Raydiant RF delivers customized, fast-paced development with an optimized time-to-market approach. We provide highly efficient RF solutions tailored to demanding applications across point-to-point communication, sensing, space systems, and special-purpose antennas. Our systems are designed to achieve higher sensitivity, longer range, reduced interference, and lower power consumption.
We believe that hardware should be modular and scalable, enabling innovation instead of limiting it. That’s why our design philosophy focuses on adaptable architectures that accelerate research and development rather than slowing it down.

Nebular Orbital is an advanced space systems initiative operated under Radar Metrics, a French technology company focused on sovereign digital infrastructure.
Nebular Orbital aims to pioneer the development of space-based cloud computing architectures, with a near-term goal of deploying a demonstrator satellite capable of edge inference and data routing from low Earth orbit (LEO), and a longer-term roadmap toward in-orbit manufacturing of modular satellite compute units.
Headquartered in Paris, France, and supported by Radar’s existing R&D and data infrastructure, Nebular brings together deep expertise in embedded systems, machine learning at the edge, sovereign cloud standards, and space-grade hardware integration. The initiative is specifically designed to align with European strategic priorities in digital autonomy, energy-efficient computation, and dual-use space innovation.

entityDescription:
Retail Rush – Company Summary
Retail Rush is a European technology and data company specializing in digital coupon solutions for retailers and brands. In strategic partnership with Epay, Global Digital Payment provider, Retail Rush delivers a closed-loop platform that supports every stage of a coupon campaign: from creation and distribution to validation, real-time redemption tracking, and advanced consumer profiling.
Retail Rush plays a key sales and marketing role for Epay’s validation and redemption services, promoting these secure solutions to brands and retailers across Europe. Epay, a Nasdaq-listed leader in digital transaction processing, provides POS-level coupon validation and fraud prevention at over 2,000 retailers across 27 countries. Retail Rush ensures that clients can access and benefit from this infrastructure via a seamless commercial process.
The Epay-Retail Rush offering includes:
Real-time validation and redemption of digital coupon codes using GS1 standards

Fraud prevention and campaign integrity through secure unique codes

Advanced AI profiling to segment and target consumers more effectively

Real-time campaign dashboards for actionable insights and performance tracking

Integration with ad platforms (e.g., Google, Meta) via Segment for automated, smart audience targeting

Through its partnerships and scalable architecture, Retail Rush empowers brands to execute high-impact digital promotions that replace paper coupons, reduce environmental footprint, and deliver measurable returns on advertising spend.
With a goal to enable over tenthousand campaigns annually by 2027, Epay-Retail Rush is setting a new standard for data-driven, secure, and intelligent couponing across Europe.

entityDescription:
INESC Microsistemas e Nanotecnologias (INESC MN) is a private, non-profit Research and Development Institute created in January 2002, from the former Solid State Technology group of INESC.
INESC MN is dedicated to leading edge R&D in strategic technological areas of micro- and nanotechnologies and the application of these technologies to electronic, biological and biomedical devices. entityDescription:
AIMechatroniX Inc. is a pioneering technology company combining artificial intelligence and mechatronic systems, led by Dr. Sean S. Kalaycioglu and Dr. Haipeng Xie. We develop next-generation solutions for space exploration, environmental sustainability, and healthcare through partnerships with York University, Toronto Metropolitan University, Dr. Robot Inc., Skinopathy and IO AI Canada.
Our Core Technology Domains:
1. AI-Enabled Cube Satellite Systems (EdgeSat): Our EdgeSat platform, developed with York University, uses CubeSat technology with on-orbit AI processing to deliver real-time insights from space through NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano integration, hyperspectral imaging, and cost-effective solutions. Applications include agriculture, water resource management, disaster management, environmental monitoring, and urban development.
2. Advanced AI Systems: We develop specialized systems including MultiModal-DermAI (with Skinopathy), edge computing solutions, computer vision systems with specialized attention mechanisms, and autonomous control systems.
3. Advanced Robotics: Building on our leadership's experience with Canadarm2 and SPDM, we design intelligent robotic platforms with Dr. Robot Inc., including exploration rovers, humanoid systems, precision manipulation tools, and defense & security applications serving 220+ organizations in 30+ countries.
4. Mechatronics and Structural Systems: Our expertise includes vibration suppression, piezoelectric technology implementation, structural health monitoring, and integrated sensing systems.
International Partnerships: York University, Toronto Metropolitan University, University of Toronto, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan University, Dr. Robot Inc., IO AI Canada, Skinopathy, and SEKNA TECH (Turkish distribution).
Leadership: Dr. Sean S. Kalaycioglu (President & CEO), Dr. Haipeng Xie (Co-founder, Director of AI & Software), and Dr. George Zhu (Technical Advisor).

Four Postulates Ltd. was founded in March 2025 by three Hungarian professionals who conduct quantum communication education and research at the Budapest University of Technology and Economics.
The company aims to promote the adoption of quantum computing and communication technologies in Hungary, fostering new levels of innovation and scientific development.
Four Postulates offers consulting services to organizations and institutions interested in quantum technologies, helping them understand and apply state-of-the-art solutions. Our main areas of focus include investigating the practical applicability of quantum algorithms, implementing quantum-based key distribution systems, and advancing research on the quantum internet for wired, free-space, and satellite networks.
Four Postulates Ltd. is committed to contributing its expertise and research results to advancing quantum technology and developing the innovation ecosystem in Hungary.
